environment.firestore_transport: 127.0.0.1:8080 transparent HTTP/2 proxy forwarding normal RPCs unchanged
environment.web: 127.0.0.1:4175, actual Import Hub/Smart Chords in Chrome
environment.isolation: Exact demo project/loopback guards, inherited cloud credentials removed, empty temporary cwd before app import prevents active .env loading
environment.rules_scope: Emulator defaults allow all; server uses Admin SDK. This validates application authorization, not deployed Firestore rules.
environment.hosted_persistence: NOT_EXECUTED; no remote write or production data used

persistence_and_auth.initial_identity: Actual API signup creates Auth emulator user/profile and returns signed application JWT; actual /auth/me/bootstrap accepts it
persistence_and_auth.fresh_identity: New Auth-emulator password sign-in yields Firebase ID token, accepted by real backend auth in a fresh browser context
persistence_and_auth.login_scope: Browser password-login form and /auth/login were not tested. Auth emulator REST sign-in is explicitly local; no live Identity Toolkit request.
persistence_and_auth.flow: Clipboard event -> Import Hub -> real import API -> editable preview -> explicit save -> real Firestore Commit -> real query/GET -> Smart Chords
persistence_and_auth.before_confirmation: No personal chord stored for the test user
persistence_and_auth.after_confirmation: Exactly one personal chord; Firestore REST content and owner match the real API/draft
persistence_and_auth.save_reopen: Exact musical content after fresh authenticated browser session and reload
persistence_and_auth.metadata: Title/artist including literal tag text, explicit original/displayed Bb and capo0 persisted; independent emulator snapshot confirms
persistence_and_auth.music: Six indented tab strings, fret numbers/techniques/harmonics, intro/interlude, Eb/G and Ab/Bb preserved
persistence_and_auth.write_failure: After a separate real app/database baseline, test-only transport injects nonretryable gRPC7 for Commit/Write while reads still reach actual emulator. UI retains reviewed title/draft, shows no success, creates no partial record and re-enables save. Explicit retry after restoring transport persists once.
persistence_and_auth.fault_limit: Controlled transport error injection is not a genuine emulator-rules/cloud-permission denial and does not simulate successful persistence.

isolation_results.forged_body_user_id: Ignored; server derives owner from actual session, verified stored ownerB and ownerA cannot read it
isolation_results.ministry_links: Own chord linked in ministry1; ministry2 remains unlinked and rejects ministry1 song reference with404
isolation_results.semantics: Personal chords are isolated by user; ministry-specific repertoire links are partitioned separately.

html_security.path: Actual clipboard payload and API -> Cheerio metadata extraction/normalizer -> real Firestore -> React preview/workspace -> PDF source DOM
html_security.result: No execution marker, no malicious HTML elements/active links and no injected-host request observed; persisted literal text remains escaped after new session and reload
html_security.meaning: Safe text rendering for tested vectors, not general HTML sanitization. Raw tags can intentionally remain as literal stored text.
html_security.pdf_scope: Only the actual PDF source DOM was checked for security; no PDF binary, fonts or alignment tests were repeated
html_security.limits: Scoped tested matrix; no exhaustive XSS proof or hosted-browser/security-policy certification. Future rich HTML rendering needs a dedicated boundary.

proven_product_fix.before: Authenticated schema-valid110041-byte import returned500 because global JSON budget was100KiB
proven_product_fix.after: Personal Smart Chords JSON import/save budget2MiB; all other global JSON routes remain at100KiB
proven_product_fix.schema: Text100000 and optional HTML200000 character limits retained
proven_product_fix.error_logging: Body-parser size/syntax failures handled before logging body-bearing errors; no parser payload echoed to logs/client

release_config.active_env_files: backend/.env and web/.env ignored/untracked, values not read or changed in C4C
release_config.ignore_fix: .env.* now ignored, with explicit template exceptions; production/staging/preview variants checked via git check-ignore
release_config.scoped_secret_review: No private-key/provider-secret shapes in changed C4C source or tracked sensitive key-file extensions. This is not an exhaustive historical repository credential audit.
preview_requirements: Explicit build-time VITE_API_URL to canonical HTTPS backend /api/v1; current code otherwise falls back to localhost
Backend CORS_ORIGIN includes exact Web origin, no credential wildcard
Preview staging Firebase/JWT server variables configured per existing fail-closed contracts, never placed in VITE values
release_config.hosted_config_values: Unknown / Not yet verified; no Vercel settings accessed/changed
release_config.local_override: Only dedicated Playwright webServer env points at loopback API; web/.env untouched

validation.final_opt_in_integrated_case: PASS - actual application services/database, no route.fulfill or repository persistence mocks
validation.independent_review: capture_review verified product fix; harness shutdown and exact404 assertions subsequently corrected
validation.shutdown_test: Updated runner handled real Auth/Firestore traffic then SIGINT exited in under1s, own API/proxy/control ports closed
validation.historical_harness_failures: First attempt assumed an optional link prompt for empty repertoire; second assumed a flat repertoire-create envelope. Fixed test assumptions only; no application-contract change or false product fix.

resume_command: Start demo-m20-c4c Auth9099/Firestore18080 emulators (FirebaseCLI13.15/Java17 used here). From backend: node --import tsx src/scripts/m20-c4c-local-server.ts. From web set M20_C4C_REAL=1 then npx playwright test --config=playwright.integration.config.ts. Default E2E skips this case without opt-in.
preservation: All earlier WIP retained. No Android/iOS/parser/renderer changes, dependencies, APK, commit, push, merge, deploy or production configuration/write.
cleanup: Owned API/proxy/control, Auth/Firestore emulators and test Web server stopped; ports3108/8080/18081/9099/18080/4175 verified closed. No other services or device settings changed.
next_gate: Local technical persistence/security gate complete. Hosted Preview/Firestore validation remains separate; obtain explicit authorization before any remote database write and verify release URL/CORS/server-only configuration.
